1.q: Can I add multiple images at once?
1.a: Yes. Select multiple JPG or PNG images or take several camera photos. Each image is placed on one PDF page.

2.q: Will images be cropped or stretched?
2.a: No. Each image fits inside the chosen paper size and margins while keeping its original proportions.

3.q: Can I change the image order?
3.a: Yes. Use the up and down arrows next to each file. This order is used when exporting PDF pages.

4.q: Can I edit the PDF afterwards?
4.a: Yes. Select Edit PDF in the results panel to open your new document in the PDF editor.

2.q: Is a shorter final part kept?
2.a: Yes. When splitting every N pages, the last part is exported even if it has fewer pages.

3.q: Why is the result a ZIP?
3.a: Multiple PDF parts are packaged in a ZIP for a single download.

1.q: Why does my PDF barely shrink?
1.a: This tool recompresses eligible JPEG images. Text-heavy PDFs, PNGs or already compressed images may offer little reduction.

2.q: Are pages removed or text rasterized?
2.a: No. This operation keeps pages and text and focuses on JPEG image compression.

3.a: Yes. Select multiple files to process them together and download the packaged results.

3.a: Marked pages are rebuilt as images, so text layers, links and form fields on those pages are removed. Unmarked pages use the regular PDF export path.
